decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - The use hereby permitted for a restaurant shall not be carried on outside the following times:08.00 - 00.00 Monday - Friday and09.00 - 00.00 Saturday, Sunday, Public and Bank HolidaysAll customers shall have vacated the premises within 30 minutes of the above closing times.
Condition : 4 - The kitchen extraction system shall be serviced not less than annually.
Condition : 5 - The ceiling/floor separation should comply with the minimum construction/insulation standards set out in the building regulations.
Condition : 6 - No amplified or music, other than soft background music, shall be played in the glazed rear extension.
Condition : 7 - The consent holder shall ensure that there is no light spill to the surrounding residential properties from the glazed rear extension.

Condition : 8 - The access doorway to the restaurant at 6 Turnham Green Terrace, shall have a minimum clear width of 900mm, a level surface or ramp between the pavements and the floor and a door handle of not more than 1m above ground level. The chairlift platform, shall be installed and be operational prior to the restaurant use commencing.
description: Refurbishment of existing restaurant, including the installation of a new shop front, extension of the basement to form a store, demolition of the existing conservatory and enclosure of the rear courtyard to form a new conservatory
